title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 6: Blood. Real.

scenes.say: Iraq. Dust. Heat. Noise. The unit moves through narrow alleys, weapons up.
scenes.visual: soldiers moving through a narrow dusty alley in Iraq, weapons raised, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a rooftop silhouette against a harsh sun, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Gunfire. Chaos erupts. Ali dives behind a vehicle, firing back.
scenes.visual: a soldier crouched behind a vehicle in a dusty street, smoke, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Q: Stay low! Then Doc screams. I'm hit!
scenes.visual: dust and smoke in an alley, blurred figures, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali grabs Doc and drags him to cover.
scenes.visual: a soldier dragging a wounded comrade behind cover, dust flying, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: This wasn't a movie. This was blood. Real. And everywhere.
scenes.visual: a dusty helmet on the ground in a quiet alley after a firefight, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: That night, in the tent, some drink, some write letters, some just stare.
scenes.visual: soldiers inside an army tent at night, lantern light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Roddy: You saved Doc's life. Ali: He would've done it for me.
scenes.visual: a soldier cleaning his rifle in silence on a cot, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: For the first time, I wasn't just surviving. I was protecting. I mattered.
scenes.visual: two soldiers sitting in silence in a tent, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Seven. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: desert stars over a military camp, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 6 of 25: Blood. Real.. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
